//: This is the RATCHETING strict typecheck gate — the only one that can actually fail CI.
`npm run typecheck` (tsconfig.json) cannot fail by design: tsconfig.base.json sets
checkJs:false, so every file in its .js `include` glob is parsed but never type-checked.
This file turns checkJs on and lists only directories/files VERIFIED to be zero-error
under `--checkJs --strict` today. Add new entries ONE AT A TIME: run
`npx tsc -p tsconfig.strict.json --noEmit` after each addition and only keep it if the
exit code stays 0. Do not silence errors with @ts-ignore/@ts-nocheck/any-casts — fix the
source or leave the file out and note it as future work.
